items.summary: Pledges to speed up vote counting.
items.title: Speed up vote counting

citations.quote: As Secretary of State, I pledge to speed up vote counting, secure our elections, and remove the chief elections officer from partisan politics.

items.summary: Pledges to secure elections so that only eligible voters cast ballots, and says he will enforce a voter ID requirement if voters approve one in 2026.
items.title: Secure elections and enforce voter ID if approved

citations.quote: As Secretary of State, I pledge to speed up vote counting, secure our elections, and remove the chief elections officer from partisan politics.
If voters pass something like voter ID in 2026, I’ll enforce it.

items.summary: Pledges to remove the chief elections officer from partisan politics and says the office should be non-partisan.
items.title: Remove the chief elections officer from partisan politics

citations.quote: As Secretary of State, I pledge to speed up vote counting, secure our elections, and remove the chief elections officer from partisan politics.
The Office of Secretary of State should be non-partisan, representing the will of the people, not answering to Sacramento political machines.

items.summary: Says he will make the Secretary of State's business division small-business friendly, including by using technology to streamline processes for business owners.
items.title: Make the business filings division small-business friendly

citations.quote: The Secretary of State's business division is "small-business friendly"

More specifically, Wagner said, California could leverage its technology use better when approaching the business climate, especially with Silicon Valley’s expertise, to streamline processes for business owners.
